free_tier.stated: none: no free allowance, trial or credit is published; plans start at USD 15 a day and access is granted after payment
free_tier.notes: The signup form asks for an email, and the terms state that access is granted after successful payment.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the rented unit is a whole Mac mini with a 256GB SSD, not an object store

retention.stated: Machines are wiped when a rental ends, is cancelled, or is terminated, and data is not recoverable afterwards.
retention.notes: The Daily plan can be paid for 24 hours only; the terms set a 24-hour minimum lease.

egress.terms: 1Gb/s internet speed on every plan; no egress allowance, quota or per-GB price is published on the pricing page

interface_detail: Remote desktop connection and SSH, with RustDesk preinstalled; VNC and NoMachine also work.
tooling: an SSH client and a remote desktop client (RustDesk or VNC) connecting to a dedicated Mac mini.
chaining: A dedicated Mac with static IP and full admin can run a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner or a coding agent for builds that need Xcode and the iOS Simulator.

limits.value: 24 hours of access per Daily rental; Apple's license sets a minimum lease of 24 hours

limits_note: Weekly is USD 89 for 7 days and monthly is USD 159 for 1 month; the Daily plan may be taken as 24 hours only or renewed daily.
binding_note: The priced unit is a fixed rental period on a single dedicated machine, so the 24-hour term of the Daily plan is what runs out first.

identity_cost.detail: Checkout is via Stripe and access is granted after successful payment; connection details are sent to the email used at checkout. The privacy notice lists name, email address, phone number if needed, and billing address as collected data.

reliability_note: Wiped and reinstalled when the rental ends; sold-out periods occur and the machine is delivered when one frees up.
confidence_note: The price, access methods and plan terms are quoted from the vendor's own pricing page, sign-in page and terms.

evidence.proved: the Daily plan is USD 15 for 24 hours of access
each plan is a dedicated Mac Mini M4 or M6
evidence.quote: Every plan is a dedicated Mac Mini M4 or M6. Pay only for what you need, cancel anytime.

evidence.quote: Prices are listed in USD unless stated otherwise and are processed via Stripe. Access is granted after successful payment.

evidence.proved: Apple's license requires a minimum 24-hour lease
evidence.quote: Apple's macOS Software License Agreement requires that Mac computers be leased for a minimum period of 24 hours. Every rental therefore has a minimum duration of 24 hours.

evidence.proved: data on the machine is wiped at the end of the rental
evidence.quote: Machines are wiped when a rental ends, is cancelled, or is terminated, and data is not recoverable afterwards.

notes: A dedicated bare-metal Mac mini by the day, week or month at fixed published rates; no free tier is offered. Egress is not priced separately on the pages read.
